label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is TP. The sink expression is response.sendRedirect(param) at line 22. The variable param is populated from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') at line 7. Although the redirect is gated by a Referer header check (lines 10-11), the destination URL (param) is never sanitized or whitelisted. Attacker-controlled input flows directly to the redirect sink, constituting an open redirect vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param retrieved and used directly in sendRedirect without domain validation
